title: Suggestions for movie magazines / blogs / channels focussed on new releases

commenti.body: Indiewire is where I look for new releases buried in the normal superhero/ franchise commercial inundation. Here's one about the upcoming release of my movie! https://www.indiewire.com/news/trailers/glitter-and-doom-teaser-indigo-girls-queer-love-story-1234953530/
